name: After recital 1
title: REPORT on the amended proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 1999/62/EC, Council Directive 1999/37/EC and Directive (EU) 2019/520 as regards the CO2 emission class of heavy-duty vehicles with trailers and clarifying and simplifying certain provisions
part_text: (1a) Member States shall retain the right to determine, within the framework of Union law, the specific conditions and methodology for road charging to vehicle combinations operating on their territory, taking into account their national transport infrastructure, economic circumstances and strategic interests. The implementation of such charging shall respect the principle of national competence over road transport policy and shall not impose disproportionate administrative or financial burdens on Member States, transport operators or vehicle owners.
